contentItem.title: 平方可公度与平方不可公度
contentItem.englishTitle: Straight lines are commensurable in square when the squares on them are measured by the same area, and incommensurable in square when the squares on them cannot possibly have any area as a common measure.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: Straight lines are commensurable in square when the squares on them are measured by the same area, and incommensurable in square when the squares on them cannot possibly have any area as a common measure.
正方形的直线为可公度,正方形的直线以同一区域测量,正方形的直线为不可公度,正方形的直线不可能以任何区域作为共同测量标准。
